name: Herzberg (Elster, Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, green and yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Herzberg (Elster) (a red stag on a green mount on white).
history: Municipal flag of Herzberg (Elster); German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Herzberg (Elster) arms — red stag on white
